entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand you sent me. It's completely useless and I want my money back now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the band?

Don't play games with me! It doesn't work! The cadence numbers are a joke. I'm not troubleshooting it, I'm returning it. Your website says 90 days. I've had it for like a week. Process the refund or I want your manager.
I understand your frustration, and I can certainly help you with that without needing to escalate the call. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name, please?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It was delivered nine days ago. You are absolutely correct, you're well within the 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Oh. You're actually doing it? Just like that? No fight?

No fight at all. The return is approved. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any postal service location. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Huh. Okay, then. That's... fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful rest of your day.
